dogecoin.text: @LafsokanTweet That's rather up to Binance, although certainly the fees they charge for listing mean we'd be looking at community vote approach.

I'll go over the questions again when I have a chance, I can see there's common themes. Some stuff we need to explain better, some stuff we need to demonstrate more of. 1.14 will be priority but I'll try to squeeze an FAQ into the work queue! - Ross
@alvarezderrick1 More functionality for us, a stabler currency for Ethereum

@aidansparkes @dogecoin_devs it isn't high, but the higher that Doge goes in USD, the higher the fees goes. If you have the lowest TX fee, and a quick TX time, people will buy, hold, and transact in Doge.
@woodygar Is that better than supporting both sides I'd there is a split? - Ross
@Flaming85475311 Have a look at EthereumX. It's not a lot more than a full node, although we need to actually release 1.14

@dogecoin_devs @aidansparkes definitely need rewards, miners need rewards. All I am saying is that people want coins that they can move easy and cheaply. The more people that utilize Doge, the more TX fees are paid. Less block reward needed. However, I like the fact that Doge is inflationary. its unique.
And we need to look into feasibility of running an Ethereum server
I need to update the CATE multi-coin client and get it to release quality
Stuff we're working on that's not the main client - I think Max is updating the Android wallet

@dogecoin_devs If you lower fees, while having shorter block times, then you will have a coin that has more utility. If you lower (not a lot) the block reward (slightly increasing Doge's scarcity) you will create more demand foe Doge. More demand, more TXs, more ppl pay fees. happy miners.
@postmattern @aidansparkes not saying we can't change at all, but I can't see a solution where we have no rewards and TX fees are viable
So we can change the balance of rewards and fees, but to me that feels like it makes us just a rebranded Bitcoin
That can be mining rewards or transaction fees or something else we haven't thought of, but it needs to be something
Let me talk economics a bit while Max fixes stuff. We need to pay for mining infrastructure, even if we moved to proof of stake we need to motivate people to put up stake
Max is having technical issues, try sending questions to @langer_hans and see if that works - Ross

@aidansparkes @dogecoin_devs we can agree to disagree. As Dogecoin increases in value, TX fees will also technically increase in value as will the block reward. You have to look beyond the now. Users will flock to the coin because it will make it ez to move, miners will also mine bc more TX means more fees.
@erhanizmirli I don't believe there are any current coins that don't have rewards. Bitcoin is closest to end of mining, and that's part of how it got $40 TX fees
@Krumbeersubb Another development team is driving it, but I'm hoping this year - Ross
@erhanizmirli okay and how do we convince miners to adopt a new client that doesn't pay them?
If we ever write up operational risks I'd note I'm doing this Q&A while dodging traffic - Ross
@mrmagna1 Not off the top of my head I'll see if we have a directory anywhere -  Ross
@Krumbeersubb One example might be voting to make payments from a charity fund, rather than trusting a small group. Wonder if we can use them to buy cryptokitties... - Ross
@fogelnikita0 Not at this time, we need to pay the miners somehow! Even if we moved to something else, block creation requires infrastructure that needs rewards to pay for

@dogecoin_devs I luv Dogecoin, & want it to be a coin that lasts. To do so I feel it to look to the future. lower TX fees/Block rewards could encourage more widespread use. miners can bite the bullet w/ expectations that the price will rise launch- Pay off as more and more users flock to Doge.
@WatchfanaticRu Any smart contract that uses Ethereum tokens should work with Dogecoin tokens basically. -  Ross
@TheBitDipper Mostly accelerating releases so we get 1.15 and 1. 16 out this year - Ross
@mrmagna1 Help encourage shops to accept it, or support those that do! - Ross
@TalattAbi @mrmagna1 There is a lot more info on the GitHub: https://t.co/0DW4lrOfG6 -Max
@Jass__minee A lot has to go into consideration for such a change. I'm not fully against it, but there would need to be some deeper research into the implications. -Max
For everyone asking about price, if I could predict markets I'd be retired on a beach by now! - Ross
@ChillinIb They didn't ask yet ;) -Max
@postmattern Things can always change, you don't have to have the current developers do it. We do however need block rewards if we want to keep transaction fees low - Ross
@Krumbeersubb Moon i guess ;) More seriously we need to ship 1.14 at some point, I wanna look at alternative solutions for light clients, then more Core updates. DOGE-ETH bridge seems fancy... -Max
@ChillinIb I fear that's one for them unfortunately - Ross
@WatchfanaticRu Like 70% chance, more if LN works
@DonAndrewBailey Personally I'd like to find a version of PoS that I'm happy with, but so far everything has issues-  Ross
@DonAndrewBailey We're working with external developers to support Doge on Ethereum to give us smart contracts

@dogecoin_devs is there an inflation target/will it be fixed supply? What is the community consensus about the current block reward, and will it be lowered?
Side note: huge fan.
@mrmagna1 We're working with other developers who are developing a Doge-Ethereum bridge, that's probably the most exciting thing right now
